about.title: Who We
about.subtitle: A two-person automation consultancy based in Ireland, helping small businesses stop drowning in manual work.
about.ludmilaBio1: After nearly a decade working across marketing and technology in Brazil, Italy, and Ireland, Ludmila founded {{brandName}} to bridge the gap between advanced AI technology and the practical needs of small to medium-sized businesses.
about.ludmilaBio2: Her journey through different markets has given her a unique perspective on the challenges small businesses face.
about.padraigBio1: Padraig is a full-stack software engineer and former History & Politics teacher.
about.padraigBio2: His approach is straightforward: simplify the complex and create practical solutions.
about.philosophyP1: We don't sell services we haven't used ourselves.
about.philosophyP2: We're not trying to be a big consultancy.
